name: Gull Rock
description: A sea stack of white-streaked rock with deep water churning at its foot. Snapper live under the cliff, and the old fishers talk about goldscale at dawn.

discovery.message: Gulls wheel over a great rock standing off the shore, joined to the land by a strip of shingle.

rock.text: You scramble out onto the rock. The sea heaves against its foot, deep and green. The gulls don't like you here.

leave.text: You climb back down to the shingle.
